name: Built In NH
old_description: Since 2004, Built in NH has been designing and building custom cabinetry for homeowners across southern New Hampshire.
about:
Founded in 2004 in Manchester, New Hampshire, Built In NH began as a custom cabinetry shop serving homeowners across southern New Hampshire. The company, led by AJ and his team, has grown steadily while maintaining a focus on personalized service.

The firm specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing custom built-in cabinetry for residential projects. Its refined process covers every step from initial design through final installation, aiming to make the experience smooth and stress-free for clients. No facility size or headcount figures are publicly disclosed.

Built In NH serves homeowners throughout southern New Hampshire, including communities such as Bedford. Its work falls squarely in the residential construction and home remodeling sectors, with projects ranging from kitchen cabinets to built-in storage solutions.

The company emphasizes a relationship-first approach, valuing strong client connections and community impact. It cites its refined, end-to-end process and commitment to quality craftsmanship as key differentiators.
